item.title: The Complete Guide to Confluence Approval Workflows (2026)
item.description: Everything you need to know about approval workflows in Confluence Cloud. Compare native options, third-party apps, and learn how to set up compliant, multi-step approval processes with version tracking and audit trails.

item.title: Your MuleSoft Documentation Is Already Stale
item.description: MuleSoft API documentation goes stale the moment you hit publish. Here is why that happens, what it costs your team, and how to fix it with live Confluence macros.

item.title: ApprovalFlow Pricing Explained: Free Tier, Per-User, and When to Upgrade
item.description: ApprovalFlow pricing breakdown for Confluence Cloud: free for up to 10 users, then $0.40/user/month. See cost examples, use-case recommendations, and when it makes sense to upgrade.

item.title: Content Governance in Confluence: Moving Beyond Page Restrictions
item.description: Content governance in Confluence requires more than page restrictions. Learn how structured approval workflows, audit trails, and analytics help teams enforce review standards, meet compliance requirements, and maintain content quality at scale.

item.title: Detecting MuleSoft Environment Drift Using Confluence
item.description: MuleSoft environment drift — where dev, staging, and production diverge — causes silent failures. Learn how MuleSight detects drift across MuleSoft environments directly inside Confluence.

item.title: How to Embed Anypoint Snapshots in Confluence Pages
item.description: Learn how to embed live MuleSoft Anypoint snapshots directly in Confluence pages using MuleSight. This tutorial covers macro types, display modes, and how to build a macro coverage page that replaces static screenshots with real-time API data.

item.title: How to Set Up Multi-Step Approvals in Confluence
item.description: Step-by-step guide to setting up multi-step approval workflows in Confluence using ApprovalFlow. Learn how to configure sequential approval stages, assign approvers, and track page approvals with a full audit trail.

item.title: How MuleSight Surfaces Integration Failures Before They Escalate
item.description: MuleSight brings MuleSoft Anypoint visibility into Confluence with drift detection, environment comparison, and scheduled incident pages — so integration failures surface before they escalate.

item.title: ApprovalFlow vs Comala vs AppFox: Confluence Approval Tools Compared
item.description: Detailed side-by-side comparison of ApprovalFlow, Comala Document Management, and AppFox Workflows for Confluence Cloud with validated claims and corrected pricing as of February 24, 2026.
